unique_measurement_comparison.aggregation: Within-measurement medians across three correlated arrival variants; still only six recorded room pairs.

scope: Measured IR structure with synthetic added noise; not clean-room ground truth, acoustic calibration, acquisition-noise validation, independent arrival annotations or listening acceptance. Three arrival variants share each noisy source and are not independent measurements.
conclusion: Small added-noise recovery gains do not prove measured decay preservation. Weak reference-profile regions change by up to 2.411 dB under conditional masks; actual clean-room/acquisition-noise and listening acceptance remain open.
